user.title: Set up Com System
user.description: Create the Com System hub. Receivers are added afterwards.

custom_receiver.title: Add a custom receiver
custom_receiver.description: Add a receiver that delivers by calling a Home Assistant action. Strings in the action data may be templates using title, message, priority, image and data.

data_description.action: The action to call, for example notify.living_room_speaker.
data_description.action_data: The data sent to the action, as YAML. Use templates such as {{ message }} for the notification content.

confirm.title: Add a receiver
confirm.description: Add {name} ({type}) as a Com System receiver? It starts enabled. Choose Ignore to stop it being offered.

reconfigure_custom.title: Edit custom receiver
reconfigure_custom.description: Add a receiver that delivers by calling a Home Assistant action. Strings in the action data may be templates using title, message, priority, image and data.

data_description.action: The action to call, for example notify.living_room_speaker.
data_description.action_data: The data sent to the action, as YAML. Use templates such as {{ message }} for the notification content.

abort.already_in_progress: This receiver is already waiting to be added.
abort.not_available: This receiver cannot be added because its type is not available or the Com System hub does not exist.

error.name_exists: A receiver with this name already exists.
error.invalid_action: Enter the action as domain.action, for example notify.mobile_app_phone.
error.unknown_action: This action is not available in Home Assistant.
error.invalid_action_data: The action data must be a mapping of fields to values.
error.invalid_template: The action data contains an invalid template.

receiver.title: Receiver options
receiver.description: Choose the people this receiver relates to. Its area is the area of its device.
